outcome: admissions to the neonatal intensive care unit
finding: The CaesAid VAD cup resulted in a significantly shorter uterine incision-to-delivery interval and lower maternal blood loss compared to forceps, with no significant difference in Apgar scores or admissions to the neonatal intensive care unit, and fewer neonatal skin injuries.
